maria (devex): FYI found a small but common gotcha in the Go quickstart generator example: using context.Background() leads to a hung process on SIGTERM in our container tests.

liam (go-sdk): thanks for flagging. can you paste the minimal repro?

maria (devex): ```go
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
```

ara (infra): seen this in e2e. the runtime pumps tokens in a goroutine and if ctx isn't cancellable the read blocks on network during shutdown.

liam (go-sdk): plan: (1) add NewGeneratorWithCancel(ctx, req) helper that returns (it, cancel) for examples, (2) make Close() idempotent and close a done channel so Next() unblocks, (3) surface reconnect/auth-refresh as iterator errors (ErrAuthReconnect) so callers can retry.

maria (devex): please also update quickstart to show signal.NotifyContext + a short note: "avoid Background for long streams" so new devs copy a safe pattern. i'll draft the blurb.
